title: Flamenco and tapas tour
text: Our tour guide Manuel was excellent! He was full of positive energy, as well as being very knowledgeable in the history of Flamenco dancing. Manuel even gave background on the type of tapas that were served at the three spots, and the wines/ vermouth that was served. He made us feel like old friends! It was a wonderful way to spend our last evening in Seville.

title: worth it! would even go again
text:
This tour was AWESOME! highly recommend. 

the meeting spot was easy to find. the stops along the way offered authentic and delicious tapas. and the flamenco show moved me nearly to tears! 

most importantly, i have to commend our guide, Manuel. he was knowledgeable, personable, and very hospitable. he taught us about the history of flamenco and the nuances of the dances and singing. he even went above and beyond to make recommendations around seville for food, dessert, and nightlife. if i had to describe Manuel in one word, it would be JOY. and that’s the emotion i felt leaving the tour. 

yo
author: kerrieh699

title: Great tapas and flamenco evening
text: Amazing few hours with Sophie. Two great stops for tapas and drinks before going to a fantastic flamenco show. Sophie was full of enthusiasm and knowledge and really brought the evening to life! Great choice of local tapas and local drinks. I particularly loved the vino de naranja!
